title: handoff.py HandoffResponse.decode missing dao_seq/path_seq type validation
description:
File: python/src/lichen/gateway/handoff.py
Lines: 385-386, 648-649

HandoffResponse.decode() extracts dao_seq and path_seq without type validation:

```python
dao_seq = data.get(_KEY_DAO_SEQ)
path_seq = data.get(_KEY_PATH_SEQ)
```

These values are later used in accept_handoff() with arithmetic:

```python
safe_dao_seq = response.dao_sequence + 1
safe_path_seq = response.path_sequence + 1
```

If a malformed response provides non-integer types (e.g., string, list, dict), this causes TypeError at line 648-649 instead of clean rejection at parse time.

The HandoffRequest.decode() method properly validates timestamp type (line 300-301):
```python
if not isinstance(timestamp, int):
    raise HandoffError("timestamp must be integer")
```

The same pattern should be applied to dao_seq and path_seq in HandoffResponse.decode().

Fix: Add after lines 385-386:
```python
if dao_seq is not None and not isinstance(dao_seq, int):
    raise HandoffError("dao_sequence must be integer")
if path_seq is not None and not isinstance(path_seq, int):
    raise HandoffError("path_sequence must be integer")
```

Impact: Fail-fast validation; prevents unexpected TypeError during handoff acceptance.
